# Third-party material

The managed component installs `maka-agent` from the npm registry; it does not
vendor the package. Compatibility overlays and protocol fixtures in this
component are derived from Apache Maka. Apache Maka is an Apache Software
Foundation incubating project licensed under Apache License 2.0.

The upstream license, notice, and incubator disclaimer from the pinned npm
artifact are retained in `apache-maka/`. Exact package version, npm integrity,
release commit, overlay base hashes, and patched hashes live in
`../provenance.json`.

- Source: <https://github.com/apache/maka>
- Release: `v0.2.0-dev.62.20260928`
- Commit: `2f32205528a4436783c800715261d4b6e286023d`
- npm package: `maka-agent@0.2.0-dev.62.20260928`
